subject: Hosted API commitment uplift — staged capacity increase + latency guard
messages:
From: Morgan Patel <morgan@shopnova.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Ramos <aisha.ramos@shopnova.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@shopnova.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — traffic surge expected Q3, request for uplift

Hi Jonas,

We ran the Q1/2 forecast and expect a sustained increase in token traffic starting July. Our engineering team recommends we move from the current 1.2M monthly tokens commit to a stepped uplift: 2M/mo for July-Sep (trial), then 3.5M/mo for the remainder of the year if latency remains under 350ms median.

Key asks:
- Confirmation of priority provisioning for July.
- Short window SLA (latency guard) during peak hours (US-EAST).
- A clear billing cadence for the trial uplift and a pro-rated invoice for July.

Can you send a mutual action plan and the procurement path so we can loop finance?

Thanks — Morgan
Head of Product, ShopNova

Attachment: q1_usage_breakdown.csv (summary)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Patel <morgan@shopnova.com>
Cc: Aisha Ramos <aisha.ramos@shopnova.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — traffic surge expected Q3, request for uplift

Morgan —

Thanks for the heads up; this is manageable. High level response and next steps:

1) Provisioning: We can stage a stepped uplift as you suggested. Operational plan:
   - July 1–31: increase reserved commit to 2,000,000 tokens/mo (trial)
   - Aug 1 onwards: scale to 3,500,000 tokens/mo contingent on the latency guard metrics and usage patterns

2) Latency guard: We can offer a peak-hour latency SLO of 350ms median for US-EAST for the July trial window. We will instrument per-route SLIs and provide daily dashboards. If median latency exceeds 350ms for more than 6 days in the month, we activate an ops playbook (throttle tuning, burst lane, partial fallback).

3) Billing & procurement: We will pro-rate July for the uplift days and issue an amended invoice. Procurement: I will send an amendment PDF for signature and a HubSpot deal update with next steps.

Next actions from our side: Lauren will draft the amendment and the provisioning matrix; Ben will validate the latency SLO configuration with infra. Can you confirm internal approval and preferred billing contact? Once procurement confirms, we will send a DocuSign link.

Best,
Jonas
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Patel <morgan@shopnova.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:17:00 -0400
Subject: Draft amendment and provisioning matrix (internal)

Team —

I drafted an amendment that captures: staged commit (2M -> 3.5M), trial window (Jul), latency guard SLO, pro-rated billing, and an option to revert to original commit if SLA breaches occur twice in a quarter. Highlights:
- Contract term: addendum to existing renewal through 2027-06-30
- Pricing: incremental token price for the uplift months at the current committed rate (no change to base pricing)
- Ops: a dedicated provisioning ticket and daily SLI report during the trial window

Ben — please check the SLO wording. Grace — can you pre-seed the provisioning matrix with required GPU pool sizes and estimated headroom? I attached the spreadsheet.

Attachment: redwood_provisioning_matrix.xlsx

Lauren
Product Sales Operations

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft amendment and provisioning matrix (internal)

Lauren —

SLO wording looks good but suggest clarifying the measurement window and the exact percentile:
- Change "350ms median" to "350ms median (p50) measured over 1-minute rolling windows, reported daily for the trial month."
- Add fallbacks: automatic routing to the burst lane if p50 > 350ms for 3 consecutive hours.

Provisioning matrix: with ShopNova's Q1 growth, we should reserve 1x extra GPU pool for the trial (estimated cost covered by the uplift). Grace, if you can add expected headcount for ops escalation, I'll sync with infra to pre-warm.

Ben
Customer Reliability Engineer

On Wed, May 19, 2026 at 10:17 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> I drafted an amendment that captures: staged commit (2M -> 3.5M), trial window (Jul), latency guard SLO, pro-rated billing, and an option to revert to original commit if SLA breaches occur twice in a quarter.

From: Morgan Patel <morgan@shopnova.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API commitment uplift — staged capacity increase + latency guard

Thanks, team. Procurement confirms we can move forward with the July trial provided we have:
- DocuSign amendment by Friday (5/22)
- A single contact for billing to receive the pro-rated invoice (Finance contact: Aisha Ramos, aisha.ramos@shopnova.com)
- Ops kickoff scheduled the week of Jun 21 to validate traffic patterns and endpoint routing

We reviewed the SLO language and are comfortable with Ben's measurement window suggestion. Please send the final amendment + DocuSign link.

— Morgan

Attachment: shopnova_q1_usage_breakdown.csv

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Patel <morgan@shopnova.com>, Aisha Ramos <aisha.ramos@shopnova.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@shopnova.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API commitment uplift — signed amendment + provisioning next steps

Morgan / Aisha —

Attached is the DocuSign link and the PDF amendment. We captured the measurement window as Ben suggested and added an ops kickoff on Jun 22 at 10:00am ET (calendar invite sent).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.example/sign/DN-4821-amendment

Summary of what we executed:
- July trial: reserved commit 2,000,000 tokens/mo (pro-rated for July 1 start)
- Post-trial scale: target commit 3,500,000 tokens/mo pending latency guard pass
- Latency SLO: 350ms median (p50) measured over 1-minute rolling windows, reported daily; burst lane auto-activation if p50 > 350ms for 3 consecutive hours
- Billing contact: Aisha Ramos <aisha.ramos@shopnova.com>

Attached: shopnova_signed_amendment.pdf

Please e-sign and I will confirm provisioning and invoice timing.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Product Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
